text:
Jordan: Heads up — after the Orbit ATS UI rollout this morning some interviewer scorecards are getting saved but not marked as 'complete', which is breaking the panel average calc for a few roles. Saw it on SWE-IC panels (CAND-9876, CAND-9911).
Ava: Ugh. Are interviewers losing the save confirmation or is the final submit button disappearing?
Jordan: Save appears, but the status stays as 'in progress'. If someone re-opens the card it shows the old values (so duplicates/overwrites).
Sam: Could be the webhook that flips status -> we've been seeing 500s around 10:03am. I'll pull logs.
Leah: We're starting debriefs in 30m for two panels — any quick workaround? We need fair scoring.
Priya: Temporary workaround: ask interviewers to take a screenshot of completed scorecards and upload to candidate's comments thread. Not ideal but preserves evidence. I'll also turn off auto-merge on the ATS panel until this is fixed.
Jordan: Thanks @Priya — tagging folks who were on affected panels: @Leah @Ava. I'll open Ops ticket with payload samples.
Ava: Sample candidate and payload: `CAND-9876` — export snippet: `{"candidate_id":"CAND-9876","interviewer":"Ava","scores":{"technical":4,"culture":3},"status":"complete"}`.
Sam: Found the 500s — the status update endpoint timed out when payload size > 12kb (new UI adds inline notes). Sending patch to retry + backoff.
Leah: Can we also remind interviewers about the new rubric weights? Some people are still using old form (weights changed from 30/30/40 -> 25/25/50). That mismatch will skew the averages even if status is fixed.
Priya: Good call. I'll schedule a 20-min async refresher and pin a short checklist in #hiring-resources. Also adding mandatory shadow session for first-time panelists this quarter.
Jordan: I'll attach the log excerpts and a minimal repro to OPS-4721. ETA for fix: 4hrs if retry patch passes QA, pushing patch now.
hiring-bot: New training session "ATS rubric refresher (20m)" created for today at 4:30pm — RSVP open. :calendar:
Ava: Thanks — I'll notify my interviewers and tell them the screenshot workaround till the patch lands. :thumbsup:
Sam: Patch merged to staging, running integration tests. Will update thread when deployed to prod.
Priya: Once prod patch is confirmed, I'll send a short note to hiring managers with steps to verify scorecard completeness and how to re-submit if needed.
Jordan: Appreciated. Filing post-mortem template now so we can capture root cause + next steps for process change (recommendation: add client-side validation for status toggles).
